title: RLPS Pack (.r14n.toml)
description: A Regulatory Localization Pack: (profile x jurisdiction) -> required compliance controls for one domain. NOT LEGAL ADVICE.

allOf.$comment: Spec section 7 (temporal split): an approved (real-jurisdiction) pack MUST state its interpretation-currency date.

strictness.description: The posture selector (wire field name: 'strictness'). Fail-closed; NOT a legal ordering; 'aggressive' != 'compliant'.

inherits.description: Parent profile tag (RFC-4647 hierarchical, e.g. 'gdpr/eu') for delta-only inheritance.

last_reviewed_against_guidance.description: Interpretation-currency date (case-law / DPA guidance), distinct from statutory effective dates.

authorities.description: OPTIONAL review record: the statutes, cases, and secondary sources the reviewer relied on. Audit metadata for the attestation only — resolvers MUST NOT vary decisions on it, and listing an authority is NOT a representation of what that authority requires (spec §6; docs/not-legal-advice.md).

citation.description: Full citation, e.g. 'Kearney v. Salomon Smith Barney, 137 P.3d 914 (Cal. 2006)'.

note.description: What the reviewer relied on it for.

allOf.$comment: Any pack claiming a real jurisdiction (inherits a non-root regime) MUST name a reviewing attorney of record + bar credential. Enforced by the linter, not expressible in pure JSON Schema across files.

legally_required.description: The fail-closed floor (governs under 'minimal'; the mandatory catch-all).

prohibited.description: Controls this profile FORBIDS — the data-minimization guard input (spec section 3): no posture may ADD a control listed here; resolvers subtract it from every resolved set. Must not intersect legally_required (linter rule).
